publisher: Kaduna State Government — Kaduna State Bureau of Statistics / Ministry of Health
name: Health Facility Analytics (HEFA)
geographicCoverage: Kaduna State; facility-level and operational snapshots are described by the platform
dataType: Public-facing facility directory, 2018 and 2025 health facility census material, facility analytics, GIS and a staff-facing data download centre
updateFrequency: Partner documentation describes monthly facility-record update cycles triggered on the 25th; this cadence has not been independently audited.
licence: Not confirmed. Obtain the applicable data-use terms before downloading or reusing records.
checkedHow: HEFA public landing page checked; cross-checked with Natview Foundation publications on the 2025 census dissemination workshop (3 Dec 2025) and HEFA registry update training (23 Jun 2026).
limitations: The public landing page lists 2018/2025 health facility census material, a facility directory, analytics, GIS and a download centre; raw 2025 census data and public bulk-export access were not independently verified.
The HEFA download portal presents a staff sign-in page. No unauthenticated public API or public bulk export has been confirmed.
The monthly update cycle triggered on the 25th is described in a partner training publication; it has not been independently audited.
Facility functionality and security statuses are administrative fields. They do not independently establish clinical quality, staffing adequacy, medicine availability or service continuity.
The 2025 census dissemination publication describes preliminary findings and dashboard comparisons with 2018; do not treat a workshop report as the underlying census dataset.

Facility directory, census, supportive-supervision, longitudinal-study and service-throughput datasets are distinct sources with different reference periods and definitions; do not combine them without a data dictionary.
Licensing and permitted reuse conditions for the underlying HEFA datasets are not confirmed.
notes: Public portal: https://hefa.kdbs.ng/. Staff download/sign-in portal: https://download.hefa.kdbs.ng/login. Access route for public raw data remains unconfirmed. Partner sources describe a monthly update cycle on the 25th and facility coverage including COEs, PHCs and health clinics.

publisher: Kaduna State Primary Health Care Board
name: Access & Equity: Multiyear Recruitment and Deployment Plan, March 2025
geographicCoverage: Kaduna State; workforce tables include cadre and LGA retirement forecast breakdowns
dataType: Administrative workforce baseline and five-year recruitment/deployment plan (2025–2029)
updateFrequency: One-time planning document; progress updates must be sourced separately
licence: Reuse terms not stated in the retrieved document; cite the Kaduna State Primary Health Care Board and confirm reuse conditions.
checkedHow: Official Kaduna State Government PDF retrieved and its workforce analysis and recruitment tables reviewed.
limitations: The document reports a planning baseline of 5,240 existing workforce against 14,240 required, with a stated gap of 9,000; this is a March 2025 plan baseline, not a current 2026 headcount.
The document's 37% figure is the Board's stated workforce coverage; it is not an independently audited measure of facility functionality or quality.
The plan describes intended recruitment and deployment for 2025–2029; it does not prove that planned staff were recruited, trained or deployed.
The staffing tables distinguish facility cadres from headquarters and zonal staff; do not collapse cadre totals without preserving the document's definitions.
notes: The plan describes facility-by-facility deployment and quarterly monitoring. Treat planned actions, approved recruitment and verified deployment as separate lifecycle states.
